purpose: Check selected binary62 TRAIN fit to distinguish observed fitting failures from generalization-only errors; no claim of causal diagnosis.
populations: Only partition=train rows from the bound62 feature inventory. Existing row metadata for all partitions is read to select TRAIN; no DEV logits are evaluated or used to choose settings. No reservedTEST files.
models: Frozen original-v9 and selected62 classification heads only; use unchanged normalization/GELU and saved threshold/mode/couplings. No fitting, threshold search or selection.
resources: CPU device only, one language at a time, batch128; no full encoder or weights download. Preserve8GiB free disk.
verification: Bind feature arrays/metadata/specs/checkpoints. Check original-v9 CPU head logits against cached original-v9 TRAIN logits with maximum absolute tolerance1e-3 and zero binary decision disagreements. Summarize binary and six-field joint errors by language/origin and original source group.
output: Retain all per-TRAIN-case scores and field predictions privately; publish aggregates and hashes. TRAIN fit is not held-out accuracy.
causality: Persistent TRAIN mistakes can motivate optimization/capacity/loss investigation but do not identify which change will work. Perfect TRAIN fit cannot establish generalization.
